# Pastor Jeff — Livingstone

Personal site of Pastor Jeff (Zhong), a Christian pastor in Guangzhou, China, who also works in international trade. Bilingual (English/Chinese).

## Free Church Tools
8 free browser-based tools for churches and Christians, built and used weekly in his own church. Local-first: data never leaves your device.
- Prayer List Manager: /en/tools/prayer-list/
- Sermon Notes: /en/tools/sermon-notes/
- Bible Study Worksheet: /en/tools/bible-worksheet/
- Bible Reading Plan Generator: /en/tools/reading-plan/
- Scripture Memorizer: /en/tools/verse-memorizer/
- Church Poster Maker: /en/tools/church-poster/
- Church Season Calendar: /en/tools/church-calendar/
- Serving Roster: /en/tools/roster/
- All tools overview: /en/tools/

## Faith Apparel
Custom Christian apparel with an online designer (upload artwork, add text, live preview): /en/products/ and /en/designer/
